title: Provider connections
description: Configure an endpoint and key once. The editor and model.yml share one configuration; cloud models remain independent.
saved: Configuration saved. The runtime will load new models without forcibly interrupting active tasks.
testCost: Testing sends a small real API request and may incur charges. Listing a model does not verify tool compatibility.
testPassed: The tool-calling probe passed for this model.
missingModel: Model configuration is missing. Reload the configuration.
empty: Add a connection or choose a YAML file containing providers.
deleteConfirm: Remove this connection and its local models. Referencing tasks will not silently switch endpoints. Cloud models are unaffected.
migrateConfirm: Group {{count}} local models by identical endpoint, key, protocol and path, preserving their IDs and capabilities. Legacy records are removed only after the file is saved.
discardConfirm: Unsaved connection and model changes will be lost.
externalChange: The file changed elsewhere. Cancel and reopen the editor to avoid overwriting external changes.
templateHint: Choose a template or enter connection details below
name: Connection name
keyKeep: Configured; leave blank to keep the current key
keyStorage: Keys entered here are stored in the local credential store; YAML contains a reference. Nothing is automatically uploaded.
clearKey: Remove the current API key from this connection
discoveryNotice: You can still add or paste model IDs when discovery is unavailable.
bulkHint: One ID per line; spaces and commas are also accepted
bulkUnsaved: Add the pasted models before saving the connection.
invalidPath: Enter a model-list path starting with /.
invalidUrl: Enter a valid HTTP(S) base URL.
invalidList: The endpoint did not return a data array of models.
discoverFailed: Model discovery failed. Manual entry is still available.
